verdict.rationale: An inference platform could plausibly let users attach MCP servers to its model APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence only shows Baseten publishing its own MCP servers for external coding agents, which is the server role, plus generic function calling, which is a developer building block. Neither shows Baseten consuming user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
